name: Fenside Crofter
title: Crofter, drowned out
examine: Some are under sacking at Dawnmead's hedge and some are still on the boards at home with the green corn.
lines: The water came up in the night. You do not hear water. That is the trouble with it.
Cut it green or lose it. Green corn keeps a week on boards. It has been a week.
Anybody with legs can carry corn. That is the whole of what we are asking.
Somebody tied kelp to the near post. Nobody has asked whose. Halvor looks at it every morning.
The sheep are on a common nobody gave us and the corn is on boards nobody made. We will settle both when there is dry ground to settle on.
A man with a level came and said the road was the road's business. The field was ours. Now it is the water's.
